# Shraman Chaudhuri Portfolio

> A personal portfolio site built with Astro and Tailwind CSS.

## Site Contents
- Home (/): Main portfolio featuring about me, skills, projects, achievements, certifications, education, and experience.
- /connect: Hub for my links.
- /caesar-cipher: Caesar cipher utility tool.
- /catalyst: Catalyst project showcase (AI-Powered Timetable Generator).
- /watcher: Watcher project showcase (Automated file organiser).
- /opendap-c3: Open-Source Digital Audio Player project.
- /openclock-c3: ESP32-C3 Smart Clock project.
- /workframe: Human Resource Management System project.
- /bsg_notes: Bharat Scouts and Guides notes.
- /resume: Link to view or download the latest resume via Google Drive.

This site is built with Astro 5, Tailwind CSS v4, and React.
